lines.say: I always started with the topic I already knew.
The easy flashcards. Forty of them.
The past-paper question I skipped. Zero.
The topic from the mock. Also zero.
Be honest. Yours looks the same.
Comfortable isn't the same as useful.
Offload builds your plan from your notes and exam dates.
It tests you, and brings weak topics back sooner.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
